issues.title: Checkout fails when payment provider sends callback
issues.description: The checkout flow returns HTTP 500 when processing the payment provider callback, preventing some customers from completing orders.

issues.title: Order confirmation email is not sent after successful checkout
issues.description: Orders are recorded, but customers do not receive confirmation emails because the notification service integration fails.

issues.title: Cart total does not refresh after quantity changes
issues.description: The displayed subtotal remains unchanged until the page is refreshed after modifying a product quantity.

issues.title: Inventory count becomes incorrect after concurrent orders
issues.description: Concurrent purchases can decrement inventory incorrectly, potentially allowing customers to order out-of-stock products.

issues.title: Expired access token causes an unhandled API error
issues.description: Requests made with expired access tokens occasionally return HTTP 500 instead of a proper HTTP 401 response.

issues.title: Product search ignores selected category filter
issues.description: Search results include products outside the selected category, making it difficult for customers to find relevant items.

issues.title: Product listing page loads slowly with large catalogs
issues.description: The product listing page takes more than five seconds to load when the catalog contains a large number of products.
